label: Mark McInerney
narrative: McInerney is the man NASA would not name. On 14 September 2023, releasing the Independent Study Team report, Administrator Bill Nelson announced that the agency had appointed a Director of UAP Research and declined to identify the appointee at the briefing; a subsequent statement named McInerney, previously NASA's liaison to the Department of Defense on limited UAP data, sensors and analysis. He is a low-visibility node with high symbolic weight: the entire NASA exercise was premised on the claim that stigma prevents scientific work on UAP, and the agency's first act on completing it was to protect its own appointee from that stigma by withholding his name. For a board built on the premise of deliberate concealment, this is a useful calibration point - it shows the same protective reflex operating in an open civil agency with nothing classified at stake, which is exactly the reflex that, inside a compartmented defence program, produces a decades-long hole in the record.
